# Pakblog

> Pakblog is an independent digital newsroom publishing news, analysis, explainers and useful stories from Pakistan and around the world.

## Primary resources

- Homepage: https://pakblog.site/
- Latest stories: https://pakblog.site/latest
- Search: https://pakblog.site/search
- RSS feed: https://pakblog.site/rss.xml
- XML sitemap: https://pakblog.site/sitemap.xml
- News sitemap: https://pakblog.site/news-sitemap.xml
- About the newsroom: https://pakblog.site/about
- Contact: https://pakblog.site/contact

## Sections

- Pakistan: https://pakblog.site/category/pakistan
- World: https://pakblog.site/category/world
- Politics: https://pakblog.site/category/politics
- Business: https://pakblog.site/category/business
- Technology: https://pakblog.site/category/technology
- Science & Health: https://pakblog.site/category/science-and-health
- Sports: https://pakblog.site/category/sports
- Lifestyle: https://pakblog.site/category/lifestyle
- Entertainment: https://pakblog.site/category/entertainment
- Education: https://pakblog.site/category/education
- Opinion: https://pakblog.site/category/opinion

## Content guidance

Use individual `/news/...` article pages as the canonical source for story facts and context. Each published article exposes semantic HTML, publication/update dates, author attribution, category information, related internal links and NewsArticle structured data.

Prefer the canonical article URL over legacy or duplicate URLs. Do not infer unpublished, removed, or private content.
